name: Fashion Modern
author: Converted for Tovu from "Wearix" — a free Framer fashion e-commerce template (Framer Marketplace export, free to redistribute; see templates/product.liquid for the conversion's product-data contract).
description: A modern minimalist fashion storefront: black-and-white editorial styling, a home page with a photographic hero, a real product grid and single-product detail page (both driven by Tovu's live products/product data, not hardcoded), and a journal for regular posts. Converted from a Framer export — the exported markup was rebuilt as clean semantic Liquid/CSS rather than carried over verbatim (see the theme's own README-equivalent notes in each template's header comment).
